name: Go Languages
description: Go navigation, editing, run, tests and coverage across independent module contexts using pinned gopls and Go tools.

capabilityDetails.buildProfiles: Simultaneous explicit GOOS/GOARCH/tags/cgo contexts; provenance and configured-scope queries. Cross-target run/test/debug is rejected.
capabilityDetails.rename: Complete text-edit previews only; independent implicit-method coverage and resource moves are blocked.
capabilityDetails.symbols: Current document outline, optionally filtered by query.
capabilityDetails.workspaceSymbols: Fuzzy symbols across included contexts; upstream truncation and package failures are explicitly partial.
capabilityDetails.run: Saved Go packages using the configured SDK, with output polling and process-group cancellation.
capabilityDetails.test: go test -json events, including subtests and optional statement coverage.
capabilityDetails.debug: Pinned Delve DAP: native breakpoint, stack, locals, watch expressions, stepping, pause/resume and cleanup verified on macOS arm64 with Go 1.25.5.
